Xander Hulk High-Airflow Mid Tower Gaming Case (4 Pre-Installed ARGB Fans / Tempered Glass Side Window) + Integrated 600W Power Supply Bundle (1-Year Local Warranty)

Build a modern gaming system with high airflow performance using the Xander Hulk Mid Tower Gaming Case bundled with an integrated 600W power supply unit, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. The Xander Hulk chassis features a high-density ventilation mesh front panel paired with 4 pre-installed 120mm ARGB cooling fans (3 front intake fans plus 1 rear exhaust fan) to deliver steady thermal airflow and vivid lighting customization across its full tempered glass side panel. Bundled with a pre-assembled 600W power supply, it offers an all-in-one solution for entry-level and mainstream gaming components. Featuring support for ATX motherboards, extended graphics cards, liquid cooling radiators, and dedicated cable management channels, this setup ensures an easy and reliable PC assembly experience.
